name: raidlead-companion
description: Desktop companion for the RaidLead WoW addon -- reads your addon's saved loot data and writes your published roster into WoW, syncing with your RaidLead account in the background once you log in (a one-time browser approval, not a stored password). Also checks raidlead.vercel.app/updates for a newer version -- it never downloads or installs anything on its own.
